name: Philadelphia Roll
reasons: Technique fried -> raw; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Cook and season sushi rice. Let cool to body temperature.
Place nori on a bamboo mat. Spread a thin, even layer of rice over the nori, right to the edges.
Flip the sheet over so rice faces down. Sprinkle sesame seeds on the rice.
Place cream cheese, salmon strips, avocado, and cucumber along the near edge of the nori.
Roll tightly using the mat. Seal the edge with a damp finger.
Slice with a very sharp wet knife into 8 pieces. Serve with soy sauce and wasabi.

name: Phở Bò
reasons: Broth alone simmers up to 4 h, plus the explicit 5 min blanch; preparation retains 30 min.

steps.display_text: Blanch beef bones in boiling water for 5 minutes. Rinse.
Char ginger and onion directly over a flame or under a broiler. Add to bones with fresh water.
Toast star anise, cinnamon, and cloves in a dry pan. Wrap in muslin and add to broth.
Simmer on very low heat for 3–4 hours, skimming foam. Season with fish sauce and salt.
Cook rice noodles in boiling water. Divide into bowls. Add thinly sliced raw beef.
Ladle boiling hot broth over noodles — it cooks the beef instantly. Serve with herbs, sprouts, lime, and hoisin.

name: Pierogi Ruskie
reasons: Technique baked -> boiled; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Make dough: combine flour, egg, warm water, and salt. Knead until smooth and elastic. Cover and rest 30 minutes.
Boil potatoes until tender. Mash. Mix with farmer's cheese and sautéed onion. Season with salt and pepper.
Roll dough thin. Cut circles with a glass. Place a teaspoon of filling in each, fold and seal tightly.
Boil in salted water for 4–5 minutes after they float. Drain.
Pan-fry boiled pierogi in butter with diced onion until golden and slightly crispy on both sides.
Serve with extra caramelised onion, crispy bacon bits, and sour cream.

name: Potato Varenyky
reasons: Technique baked -> boiled; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Make dough: combine flour, egg, water, and salt. Knead 5–7 minutes until smooth. Rest 30 minutes covered.
Boil potatoes until tender. Mash with butter and salt.
Caramelise diced onion in butter until golden. Mix half into mashed potato for the filling.
Roll dough thin. Cut circles with a glass. Place a teaspoon of filling in each.
Fold and pinch edges tightly to seal. Boil in salted water for 4–5 minutes after they float.
Toss with remaining caramelised onion. Serve with sour cream and fresh dill.
Combine lamb and beef mince with grated onion, minced garlic, fresh mint, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Knead the mixture vigorously for 3 minutes. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Shape into small oval meatballs or elongated fingers.
Grill on a very hot grill or pan for 3–4 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Serve with warm flatbread, plain yogurt, sliced tomato, and onion.

name: Quiche Lorraine
reasons: Pastry chill 15 min + blind bake 20 min + filled bake up to 35 min, plus 20 min preparation.

steps.display_text: Line a tart tin with shortcrust pastry. Chill for 15 minutes.
Blind bake pastry at 180°C for 15 minutes (line with paper and beans). Remove beans, bake 5 more minutes.
Fry bacon lardons until golden. Drain and scatter over pastry base with grated Gruyère.
Whisk together eggs, double cream, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Pour custard into the tart shell. Bake at 160°C for 30–35 minutes until just set with a slight wobble.
Cool slightly before slicing. Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Roast Red Pepper Soup
reasons: Roast 25 min then simmer 10 min, with 5 min allowance for sauteing aromatics.

steps.display_text: Halve peppers and roast cut-side down at 200°C for 25 minutes until charred. Peel.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add tomatoes, roasted peppers, smoked paprika, and stock.
Simmer 10 minutes. Blend until completely smooth.
Return to pan, stir in cream. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with a swirl of cream and croutons.

name: Roasted Beet and Feta Salad
reasons: Beets roast up to 50 min, plus an editorial 20 min cooling allowance before peeling and assembly.

steps.display_text: Wrap whole beets in foil and roast at 200°C for 45–50 minutes until tender. Cool and peel.
Slice or quarter beets. Toast walnuts in a dry pan.
Make dressing: whisk balsamic vinegar, honey, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Arrange rocket on plates. Add beets and crumbled feta.
Scatter walnuts over. Drizzle with dressing and serve immediately.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Soup
reasons: Roast 25 min then simmer 10 min, with 5 min allowance for sauteing aromatics.

steps.display_text: Halve peppers and place cut-side down on a tray. Roast at 200°C for 25 minutes until charred. Peel.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add canned tomatoes and smoked paprika.
Add roasted peppers and vegetable stock. Simmer 10 minutes.
Blend until completely smooth. Pass through a sieve if desired.
Return to pan, stir in cream, season. Serve with a swirl of cream and crusty bread.

name: Rote Grütze (Red Berry Pudding)
reasons: Technique baked -> simmered; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Combine all berries and cherries in a saucepan with sugar and a splash of water.
Heat gently until berries soften and release juice, about 5 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with cold water. Stir into the bubbling berries.
Cook 2–3 minutes until the mixture thickens. Do not overcook — keep it glossy.
Pour into individual glasses. Cool, then refrigerate. Serve with vanilla sauce or cream.
